ambient_patch.name: Slow Circuits — Ambient Patch
ambient_patch.description: A playable generative ambient console: three clocks, seeded chance, pentatonic pitch, Ada's Discreet pad and FM piano, a 29-second LFO, filter, stereo echoes and reverb. Six physical sliders and four pushbuttons. Fixed signal path; the LFO can be routed to filter or stereo pan. Silent until PLAY. Flat printed text and a real output waveform. Eight voices and two shared baked notes; native effects, asynchronous synthesis, no per-sample work on the rendering thread. ENTER ROOM opens Room Memory, a recursive voice experiment after Alvin Lucier; the earlier generative ambient room is available inside. Return restores this hall.

ambient_listening_room.name: Slow Circuits — Walk-in Instrument
ambient_listening_room.description: A 6.4-metre round instrument room with an open floor, physical Rhythm/Tone/Space stations, flat wall text, actual PCM waveform and three spatial sound sources. Enter using AMBIENT ROOM inside Room Memory; the staged scene supplies the existing VR rig and a return to WaveFunctions_Synthesis_Lab.
interactions: Walk between Rhythm, Tone and Space stations

room_memory.name: Room Memory - after Alvin Lucier
room_memory.description: A walkable 6 x 5 x 3 metre room. Record a short local phrase or use a labelled synthetic demo. Each pass filters the previous PCM through a bounded three-axis resonance model. Compare the original, run up to 24 passes, or change absorption and restart from the same voice. Native physical controls and flat text. Simplified algorithmic acoustics, not a measured room response.
room_memory.qfep_connection: A repeated spatial filter selects what can remain audible. The visitor can compare the surviving resonances with the original voice and change that selection. The model is explicit: the CGI walls obtain acoustic effects only through authored rules.
